reviewCriteria: Chinese literature chapter opening uses 2em CLREQ indentation and zero inter-paragraph margin
quotation has a visible border, percentage horizontal margins, and no body first-line indent
technical listing retains indentation and readable monospace line-height
table is legible and semantically captioned
notes retain visible backlinks without distorting superscript line rhythm
reviewNote: Inspected pinned linux-arm64-noble-v2 candidates against W3C CLREQ, JLREQ, Amazon Kindle Reflowable Text, and Apple Books Asset Guide 5.3.1. Chinese literature chapter and section openings now retain 2em first-line indentation with zero inter-paragraph margin between consecutive narrative paragraphs, percentage horizontal quote margins, and a centered subtle horizontal rule. Technical reference retains unindented 0.65em block spacing, balanced callout/note padding, non-distorting superscript line rhythm, legible 0.9em monospace listings with 1.45 line-height, and clean left-bordered footnote entries. Browser regressions also verify Japanese 1em and English flush-left opening vs 1.5em body indentation.
